basic_info.description: Magnificent Mediterranean Pacific Ocean view home tucked away on a wonderful block, close to West Portal Village shops, restaurants & Muni Station! Lovely garden entrance w/paver walkway & brick staircase leads to an arched portico w/notable 12-panel beveled-glass front door & into a gracious foyer w/coat closet & an ideal center hall floor plan with 'picture gallery' hallway & skylight. Spectacular formal living rm w/vaulted ceiling & recessed lighting boasts a fireplace w/classic mantel, built-in bookshelves, huge five-sided bay window & parquet hardwood floors. Splendid formal dining rm w/striking chandelier! Impressive remodeled gourmet kitchen showcases all stainless-steel appliances incl a six-burner gas range top & sep double oven, quartz counters, gorgeous custom wood cabinets, built-in buffet & great walk-in pantry. Sumptuous, private master suite level atop w/sweeping views from the Olympic Club to the Pacific Ocean, wall-to-wall closets & a fabulous, en-suite bath w/dual vanity sink, big walk-in shower & sep water closet. Full basement level incl walk-in wine cellar, potting rm, workbench & ample storage. Extraordinary park-like landscaped backyard w/large walk-out deck, spacious patio w/built-in seating, night-lighting, fountain & lush garden w/mature plants & trees!
